title: Lattice Yang-Mills theory: spacing-uniform obstructions, the mass gap up to the Dobrushin ceiling, and Lean certificate
description: Two RevTeX papers and a Lean 4/Mathlib certificate. (1) Spacing-Uniform Lattice Inequalities Cannot Produce the Yang-Mills Mass Gap: a lattice gap uniform in lattice units forces vanishing continuum two-point functions; volume, cumulant, Bianchi, running-coupling and curvature obstructions; the open residual (Hypothesis R). (2) Mass Gap of Lattice Yang-Mills Theory up to the Dobrushin Ceiling: the sharp Hessian bound 4d, uniqueness and a lattice mass gap for |beta|<1/(8d), the sharp quarter W1(nu_b,nu_b') <= |b-b'|/4 for von Mises-Fisher laws on the three-sphere, and hence uniqueness and a lattice mass gap m >= -log(9 beta_W/2) for four-dimensional SU(2) up to beta_W = 2/9, the ceiling of all single-link Dobrushin arguments; a gauge-invariant finite-box criterion. The continuum Yang-Mills existence and mass-gap problem remains open. Lean: 63 theorems, no sorry, standard axioms only.
